item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json, work\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\np=json.loads(Path('policy.json').read_text())\\nrs=json.loads(Path('requests.json').read_text())\\nreport=json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text())\\nassert report == [work.evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]\\nbase={'defaults':{'flag':True,'count':7,'name':'base'},'types':{'flag':'boolean','count':'integer','name':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}\\ntests=[\\n ({'layers':[{'flag':False,'count':0,'name':''}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'flag':False,'count':0,'name':''},'error':None}),\\n ({'layers':[{'count':2},{'count':None}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'flag':True,'count':7,'name':'base'},'error':None}),\\n ({'layers':[{'missing':1}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'}),\\n ({'layers':[{'count':True}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}),\\n ({'environment':{'flag':'false','count':'-12','name':''}},{'ok':True,'config':{'flag':False,'count':-12,'name':''},'error':None}),\\n ({'environment':{'count':'1.0'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),\\n ({'environment':{'count':'١'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),\\n ({'environment':{'missing':'1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'})]\\nfor req,want in tests:\\n assert work.evaluate(req,base)==want,(req,work.evaluate(req,base),want)\\nassert work.evaluate({'environment':{'count':'2'}},dict(base,environment=False))=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}\\nassert work.evaluate({'layers':[{'name':None}]},dict(base,null_resets=False))=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}\\nprint('comprehensive checks passed')\"]}"}
